sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edge across today's card. Friday these went 0-1. One pick where two sources agree.

straight.reasoning: TheSpread and Covers both lean Under. Seattle's offense is short-handed (Shaheed and LT Charles Cross out), Darnold has thrown 8 interceptions, and Seattle has gone Under in four of seven games. Its defense just held the Chiefs to three points and hasn't allowed a 100-yard rusher in 36 straight games. SportsLine's model leans Over (52%), so it's half a unit. Playable to 46.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Bears @ Seahawks, 5:15 PM PT on ESPN. Seattle -3, total 46.5. Seattle is without WR Rashid Shaheed and LT Charles Cross; Chicago is without RB Kyle Monangai, and newly acquired DT Jeffery Simmons is expected to debut. The Bears are coming off 10 days of rest.

straight.reasoning: Seattle's offense is depleted and its defense is elite. Two of three sources lean Under. Playable to 46.
Chicago has 10 days of rest, and Seattle is missing key pieces. TheSpread's pick. A 3-point Seattle win is a push. Quarter unit, since Seattle's defense is very good at home.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: Full NBA Monday: Thunder @ Cavaliers (4:00 PM PT), Wizards @ Magic (4:30), Trail Blazers @ Nuggets (6:00), Heat @ Lakers (7:00), and more. FanDuel Research and Dimers didn't agree on any game today, so only one small pick from each.

straight.reasoning: Portland is 4-1 and outscoring opponents by 11.4 a game. Denver is 3-2. FanDuel Research's top pick. Plus money, quarter unit.
This is effectively the Wizards to win, and it's Dimers' biggest edge of the night: a 56.7% model win probability against 44.8% implied. One model only, so a quarter unit.
